seo.title: Prometer | Enterprise Tracking & CRM System
seo.description: Prometer is an integrated enterprise solution for workforce management, shipment tracking, and customer relationship management, designed for operational excellence.
seo.keywords: prometer, employee tracking, shipment tracking, enterprise crm, logistics management, workforce optimization

project.title: Prometer
project.shortDesc: An all-in-one enterprise ecosystem for tracking personnel, managing logistics, and streamlining customer relations.

overview.about: Prometer is an industrial-grade enterprise platform engineered to solve complex operational challenges. It bridges the gap between field operations and administrative management by providing real-time tracking for both shipments and employees, integrated with a powerful CRM module.
overview.goal: To provide a unified command center for logistics companies to monitor their fleet, track employee performance, and maintain high-quality customer relationships.
overview.audience: Operations managers, fleet supervisors, HR departments, and customer support teams.

challenge.description: The main technical hurdle was synchronizing high-frequency GPS data from thousands of field agents while maintaining a responsive CRM interface. We needed to ensure data integrity across multiple operational branches.
points: Seamless integration of CRM with logistics data

solution.description: We developed a modular architecture using high-performance data streams and a distributed database system. The interface was optimized for rapid data entry and clear visual monitoring of field assets.
solution.approach: Data-driven operational management with a focus on real-time visibility and communication.

features.title: Personnel Tracking
features.desc: Live GPS monitoring and shift management for field employees and delivery agents.

features.title: Shipment Lifecycle
features.desc: End-to-end tracking of goods with automated status updates and digital signatures.

features.title: Integrated CRM
features.desc: Centralized database for client interactions, support tickets, and sales pipelines.

features.title: Predictive Analytics
features.desc: AI-powered insights into delivery times, workforce efficiency, and customer trends.

design.philosophy: Functional, robust, and professional. Focus on data density without sacrificing clarity, using a high-contrast industrial palette.

results.impact: Boosted operational efficiency by 35% and improved customer response times by 50% within the first six months.

strategy.title: Optimizing Internal Flow
strategy.desc: Creating a digital backbone for complex physical operations.

steps.title: Geofencing
steps.desc: Implementing precise area-based tracking and alerts.

steps.title: CRM Context
steps.desc: Linking shipping data directly to customer profiles.

typography.quote: Clarity is the ultimate goal of enterprise design.

compatibility.title: Cross-Platform Sync
